PNC Media and Entertainment Limited conducted its 33rd Annual General Meeting virtually on September 28, 2026. Key ordinary resolutions transacted included the adoption of FY26 audited standalone and consolidated financial statements and the re-appointment of retiring director Mrs. Rina Pritish Nandy.

The company reported no qualifications or adverse remarks in its statutory or secretarial audit reports. The consolidated e-voting results and the Scrutinizer's Report will be submitted to the stock exchanges within two working days of the meeting's conclusion.

Source: BSE
